steps.path: INSTALLED on Marketplace cards; Working / Inactive in the session list
steps.headline: How should small status labels look?
steps.notice: Top of each picture: INSTALLED on two Marketplace cards. Bottom: Working in the session list. Every version drops the capital letters, as you chose for section labels.
steps.risk: Session labels already carry their own colored dot, so there "Dot and word" and "Quiet words" look almost the same; the Marketplace cards show the difference.

variants.label: Today
variants.summary: Small capitals in a grey pill on cards; a tinted pill with a dot in the session list.

variants.label: Tinted pill
variants.summary: A soft pill in the label's color, normal case.

variants.label: Dot and word
variants.summary: A small dot followed by the word, no pill.

variants.label: Quiet words
variants.summary: Just small grey words, no pill and no extra dot.

steps.path: Settings → Backup & Sync, with conversations too big to sync
steps.headline: How should a warning or notice sit on the page?
steps.notice: Look at the orange notice: "2 conversations too big to sync". The same style would be used for every passive warning, info and danger notice in the app.

variants.label: Tinted box
variants.summary: Today: a softly tinted box with a matching border.

variants.label: Side bar
variants.summary: No box: a colored bar down the left edge beside the text.

variants.label: Plain
variants.summary: No box and no bar: the colored title and the text sit directly on the page.
